<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me collect all variants at position 0 by cycling through them
# First, record the current symbol, then press UP 11 more times to get all 12

current = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def extract_5x5(grid, r0, c0):
    lines = []
    for r in range(r0, r0+5):
        line = grid[r][c0:c0+5]
        lines.append(''.join('B' if c == 'B' else '.' for c in line))
    return '\n'.join(lines)

# Current symbol at pos 0
variants = [extract_5x5(current, 52, 15)]

# Press UP 11 times and record each
action(['UP'] * 11)

# Now collect symbols from history
for h in history:
    frame = h.frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sym = extract_5x5(frame, 52, 15)
    if sym not in variants:
        variants.append(sym)

print(f"Total unique variants at pos 0: {len(variants)}")
for i, v in enumerate(variants):
    print(f"  V{i}:\n{v}\n")

# Compare to top grid
initial = history[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')
top_positions = [
    (5, 13), (5, 23), (5, 36), (5, 46),
    (14, 13), (14, 23), (14, 36), (14, 46),
    (23, 13), (23, 23), (23, 36), (23, 46),
]
top_symbols = [extract_5x5(initial, r, c) for r, c in top_positions]

print("\nVariant-to-top matching:")
for i, v in enumerate(variants):
    matches = [ti for ti, ts in enumerate(top_symbols) if ts == v]
    print(f"  V{i} matches top: {matches}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
